changes.replacement: The synchronous method returns MarkdownDocument. ToMarkdownAsync returns OfficeConversionResult<MarkdownDocument>. Cast the report to LatexToMarkdownReport for native spans/diagnostics. SaveAsMarkdown(path|stream) returns the same typed evidence. FailOnLoss rejects before persistence.

The synchronous method returns LatexDocument. ToLatexAsync returns OfficeConversionResult<LatexDocument>. Cast the report to MarkdownToLatexReport for native spans/diagnostics and GeneratedSource for the exact canonical text. SaveAsLatex(path|stream) writes that text and returns the same typed evidence.

ToTarget(options, out OfficeConversionReport, cancellationToken) returns the native target. ToTargetAsync returns OfficeConversionResult<T>. Cast the out/result report to its typed conversion report; generated AsciiDoc/LaTeX source is retained by GeneratedSource on the typed report. The specialized result only serves internal projection.
